AT LEAST nine meat shops and

the Ram Path leading to Ayodhya
and the Ram temple, are to close
following a resolution of the
Ayodhya municipal corporation
which cited the road's religious
significance.
This has prompted the city’s
trade association to demand that

13-km-longRam Path starts from
Sadatganj and leads to Lata
Mangeshkar Chowk in Ayodhya.
With shops on either side, it had
a makeover when the road was
widened. It also links to the Shri
Ram Janmabhoomi Path, which
leads tothe Ram temple site,and
the Bhakti Path that connects
Shringar Ghat to Hanuman Garhi.

ligious significance of the stretch.

articles.body_raw:
NEW DELHI, MAY 2

THE SUPREMECOURT Friday re-
jected steel major JSW Steel Ltd’s
Rs 19,000 crore bid to acquire
Bhushan Power and Steel Ltd
(BPSL) through the Corporate
Insolvency Resolution Process
(CIRP) route, and ordered the liq-
uidation of the company.
JSW acquired BPSL in March

2021 under the Insolvency and
Bankruptcy code. JSW Group
Chairman and Managing
Director Sajjan Jindal had then
said that the acquisition had
helped the group make an entry
into Odisha and east India.
